papers.title_en: BlindPSNR: A No-Reference Fidelity Predictor for Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.authors: Mingzhe Lyu, Jinqiang Cui, Hong Zhang
papers.evidence: 低光图像增强的无参考图像质量评价
papers.tldr: 低光图像增强（LLIE）方法的可调参数通常固定，导致跨场景性能下降，而手动选择最优参数耗时且不总可行。虽然峰值信噪比（PSNR）是自然的保真度准则，但需要不可得的参考图像；现有无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）方法关注感知质量而非信号保真度，在基准测试上参数选择准确率均为0%。本文利用成对训练数据中PSNR可解析计算的特点，提出BlindPSNR——一个轻量级无参考网络，通过窗口交叉注意力融合增强图像与退化低光输入，并以异方差回归估计PSNR。标量回归基线仅达54.4%的Top-1准确率，BlindPSNR将其提升至89.5%，平均遗憾从1.62 dB降至0.026 dB，且能泛化到未见数据集（SRCC 0.61-0.67），为低光增强自动参数优化提供首个可靠的无参考保真度预测器。
papers.abstract_en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods involve tunable parameters that are typically fixed, often leading to performance degradation when applied across scenes. Manually selecting the best configuration, however, can be time-consuming and not always practical. Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) is the natural fidelity criterion for automating parameter selection, yet it requires a ground-truth reference that is typically unavailable. To our knowledge, no learning-based method addresses no-reference PSNR prediction for low-light image enhancement; the natural surrogate, no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA), targets perceptual quality rather than signal fidelity, and all seven baselines we test achieve 0% top-1 selection accuracy on our benchmark. With paired training data, the ground-truth PSNR is analytically computable, providing exact supervision without a separate teacher network. Building on this, we propose BlindPSNR, a lightweight no-reference network that fuses the enhanced image with the degraded low-light input via windowed cross-attention and estimates PSNR through heteroscedastic regression. While a scalar-regression baseline achieves top-1 accuracy of 54.4%, BlindPSNR raises this to 89.5% with regret dropping from 1.62 dB to 0.026 dB, and generalizes to unseen datasets (SRCC = 0.61-0.67).
